text: The Portman Travel Group Limited's Companies House persons-with-significant-control register records an active statement, notified on 1 January 2018, that 'the company knows or has reasonable cause to believe that there is no registrable person or registrable relevant legal entity in relation to the company'.
short: No registrable person with significant control is recorded for The Portman Travel Group Limited.

source.name: Companies House: persons with significant control, THE PORTMAN TRAVEL GROUP LIMITED (08831424)
source.quote: there is no registrable person or registrable relevant legal entity in relation to the company
source.note: Register page without a date, opened 2026-10-03: '0 active persons with significant control / 1 active statement'. The one ceased PSC entry, Dr Nasser Aqeel Al Tayyar (Saudi national; more than 25% but not more than 50% of shares), ceased on 1 January 2018.
